heading: Automatic updates install again
summary: Updates from PromeFTP 1.1.15 and 1.1.17 failed after download with an installer launch error. This release fixes the update installer, and keyboard shortcuts can be changed by clicking them.
changes: Updates download and install again. Builds 1.1.15 and 1.1.17 could not install because the updater helper was missing from the app.
In Preferences → Shortcuts, click a shortcut to change it, then press the new keys. Escape cancels and Delete clears it.
notice: If you run 1.1.15 or 1.1.17, install 1.1.18 once from the DMG on this release page. Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
